register.subject: Verify Account
register.title: Verify Your Email Address
register.subtitle: Welcome to our platform!
register.intro: Thanks for signing up with AutoSouk! We're excited to have you on board. To complete your registration and secure your account, please verify your email address by clicking the button below.
register.security_text_one: This verification link will expire in {{count}} minute for your security. If you didn't create an account with us, you can safely ignore this email.
register.security_text_other: This verification link will expire in {{count}} minutes for your security. If you didn't create an account with us, you can safely ignore this email.
register.support_text: Having trouble with verification? Don't hesitate to reach out to our support team at

forgot_password.subject: Password reset request for your account
forgot_password.title: Reset Your Password
forgot_password.subtitle: Password Reset Request
forgot_password.intro: We received a request to reset the password for your AutoSouk account. If you made this request, click the button below to create a new password.
forgot_password.security_text: If you believe this request was made in error or by someone else, please ignore this email and consider changing your password immediately through your account settings.
forgot_password.not_requested_text: If you didn't request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email. Your password will remain unchanged, and no further action is required.
forgot_password.support_text: Need help or have security concerns? Contact our support team immediately at

inspection_report.subject: Your AutoSouk inspection report is ready
inspection_report.body: The inspection report for the vehicle you were following is now available.

identity_approved.subject: Your identity is verified
identity_approved.body: An AutoSouk admin checked your face video. All AutoSouk features are now open to you.

identity_rejected.subject: We couldn't verify your identity
identity_rejected.body: An AutoSouk admin couldn't verify your face video.

new_sign_in.subject: New sign-in to your AutoSouk account
new_sign_in.body: Your account was just used to sign in on {{device}} (IP {{ip}}) on {{time}}.
new_sign_in.warning: If it wasn't you, reset your password now and sign that device out from your account settings.

mechanic_documents_approved.subject: Your documents are approved
mechanic_documents_approved.body: An AutoSouk admin checked your documents. Buyers can now book you for inspections.

mechanic_documents_rejected.subject: A document needs a fix
mechanic_documents_rejected.body: An AutoSouk admin couldn't approve these documents. Upload them again so buyers can book you.

account_suspended.subject: Your AutoSouk account is suspended
account_suspended.body: An AutoSouk admin suspended your account on {{date}}. You can't sign in, and buyers no longer see your listings or your workshop.
account_suspended.next: If you think this is a mistake, reply to this email and tell us why.

account_reactivated.subject: Your AutoSouk account is active again
account_reactivated.body: An AutoSouk admin lifted the suspension of your account on {{date}}. Buyers see your listings and your workshop again.
account_reactivated.next: You can sign in as before.

verification_approved.subject: You're verified on AutoSouk
verification_approved.body: An AutoSouk admin checked what you sent. Everything is approved.

verification_rejected.subject: Something needs a fix on AutoSouk
verification_rejected.body: An AutoSouk admin checked what you sent. Send again what isn't approved; the reasons are below.

listing_approved.subject: Your listing is live on AutoSouk
listing_approved.body: Good news: your listing “{{title}}” was approved. Buyers can now see it and book an inspection.
listing_approved.next: Keep its price and photos up to date so buyers trust it.

listing_rejected.subject: Your listing needs changes
listing_rejected.body: An AutoSouk admin couldn't approve your listing “{{title}}” yet.
listing_rejected.next: Edit the listing to fix it. It goes back for review as soon as you save.
